Summaries of a profile as a data frame

Source: R/accessors.R
profile_summary.Rd

Returns the diagnostics of a reliability profile, or their posterior means and intervals, as a data frame with one row for each quantity.

Usage

profile_summary(x, level = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class reliability_profile, reliability_posterior, reliability_draws, reliability_design or profile_comparison.

level

Probability content of the posterior intervals, a number between 0 and 1. NULL, the default, uses the level of the fit. Not used for a profile at a fixed between-site SD.

...

Must be empty.

Value

A data frame with one row per quantity and the columns

  • quantity: the code of the quantity.

  • mean, sd, lower, upper: the posterior mean and standard deviation and the ends of the central posterior interval.

  • for draws, mcse and ess: the Monte Carlo standard error of the mean and the effective sample size of the draws.

  • for a design, allocation: the planned allocation, or the balanced one (equal spending with costs).

  • for a comparison, analysis, the name of the analysis, and mcse.

Details

The quantities are coded as in the rest of the package: I (informativeness), mean (mean reliability), harmonic (harmonic centroid), H (dispersion), V (logit variance), J_eff (concentration count) and sigma_tau (between-site standard deviation). A posterior fit or draws add sigma_tau2 and either effect_mean, the mean of the effects, or coef_<name> for each coefficient of a mean model. For a profile at a fixed sigma_tau, the column mean contains the value of each quantity and the other columns are NA.

See also

site_table() for the sites, and report_table() for a table for a report.

Examples

prof <- reliability_profile(se = c(0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30), sigma_tau = 0.2)
profile_summary(prof)
#>    quantity       mean sd lower upper
#> 1         I 0.57142857 NA    NA    NA
#> 2      mean 0.56192308 NA    NA    NA
#> 3  harmonic 0.49612403 NA    NA    NA
#> 4         H 0.07569242 NA    NA    NA
#> 5         V 0.64485497 NA    NA    NA
#> 6     J_eff 3.62347623 NA    NA    NA
#> 7 sigma_tau 0.20000000 NA    NA    NA
